label: m1-baseline-f3-s7-good
note: Baseline sample 7 (control arm, true POR, disk boot). USER-CONFIRMED LIT (desktop content). Software: dsi_isr=41 (= the known good-boot value, matching s2), l1=0, reset_failure=0. PURPOSE: this is the GOOD-boot reference needed to test the 方案C GDSC HW_CTRL_SKIP_DIS candidate. RESULT = CANDIDATE FALSIFIED: GDSC genpd state is IDENTICAL on good and bad boots (mdss_gdsc=on / mdss_int2_gdsc=off-0 in s7 GOOD, s4 BAD, s6 BAD). So pm_genpd observable state has NO discriminative power for Q28. CAVEAT: this falsifies the 'zero-cost read-only discriminator via pm_genpd' route, not the HW_CONTROL_MASK register bit itself - pm_genpd exposes the genpd state machine view (and mdss_gdsc is always on because display-subsystem holds it), not the gdscr raw value; reading the latter needs a kernel-side hook since /dev/mem is blocked by CONFIG_STRICT_DEVMEM=y. => No arm should be built for this candidate on this basis. Baseline session tally: s2 GOOD/s4 BAD/s6 BAD/s7 GOOD = 2 GOOD/2 BAD = 50%, consistent with the standing ~50% clustered understanding.
